if (minutes < 60) return `${minutes}m ago`;\n  const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);\n  if (hours < 24) return `${hours}h ago`;\n  return `${Math.floor(hours / 24)}d state"},{"owner":"hushh-webapp/lib/one-location/request-recipient-status.ts","line":85,"name":"requestRecipientStatus","exact_source_template":"export function requestRecipientStatus(input: {\n  recipientUserId: string;\n  /** Requests THIS person sent, i.e. outgoing. */\n  requestedByMe: readonly OneLocationAccessRequest[];\n  /** Grants shared WITH this person, i.e. incoming. */\n  receivedGrants: readonly OneLocationGrant[];\n  nowMs: number;\n}): RequestRecipientStatus {\n  const { recipientUserId, requestedByMe, receivedGrants, nowMs } = input;\n\n  // The unanswered ask, whatever else is true. Resolved before the active-grant\n  // branch because a request for MORE time is made by someone who is already\n  // being shared with -- so a row that let \"Live\" win said \"Sharing with you,\n  // 59 more min\" and nothing else, and the extra time this person had just\n  // asked for left no trace anywhere on the screen they asked it from.\n  const pending = requestedByMe\n    .filter(\n      (request) =>\n        request.ownerUserId === recipientUserId &&\n        isLocationRequestPending(request, nowMs),\n    )\n    .sort(\n      (left, right) =>\n        (timestamp(right.requestedAt) ?? 0) -\n        (timestamp(left.requestedAt) ?? 0),\n    )[0];\n\n  // Already sharing beats everything else. Asking somebody to share when they\n  // already are is the clearest possible sign the list is not looking.\n  const activeGrant = receivedGrants.find((grant) => {\n    if (grant.ownerUserId !== recipientUserId || grant.status !== \"active\") {\n      return false;\n    }\n    // A timed grant is no longer live at its exact deadline, even when a\n    // cached API row has not yet been settled to `expired`. Only an explicit\n    // null is open-ended; a missing or malformed deadline is not enough to\n    // claim that somebody is still sharing their location.\n    if (grant.expiresAt === null) return true;\n    const expiresAt = timestamp(grant.expiresAt);\n    return expiresAt !== null && expiresAt > nowMs;\n  });\n  if (activeGrant) {\n    const expiresAt = timestamp(activeGrant.expiresAt);\n    const remaining =\n      expiresAt === null ? null : shortRemaining(expiresAt, nowMs);\n    const live = remaining\n      ? `Sharing with you, ${remaining} left`\n      : \"Sharing with you now\";\n    if (pending) {\n      // Both facts at once, because both are true and each one alone misleads:\n      // the share IS live, and more time HAS been asked for and not answered.\n      const askedFor =\n        pending.requestedDurationMode === \"until_stopped\"\n          ? \"no end time\"\n          : formatLocationDurationLabel(pending.requestedDurationHours)\n            ? `${formatLocationDurationLabel(pending.requestedDurationHours)} more`\n            : \"\";\n      return {\n        subtitle: askedFor\n          ? `${live} · asked for ${askedFor}`\n          : `${live} · asked for more time`,\n        tone: \"pending\",\n        statusLabel: \"Asked\",\n        // The extra time is the owner's to give. Asking a third time from here\n        // would only overwrite the number they are already looking at.\n        selectable: false,\n      };\n    }\n    return {\n      subtitle: live,\n      tone: \"ready\",\n      statusLabel: \"Live\",\n      selectable: false,\n    };\n  }\n\n  // The unanswered ask with no live share behind it. \"\").trim();\n  const grantIds: string[] = [];\n  const delivery: SosDeliveryOutcome[] = [];\n  const incidentSoFar = (): SosIncident => ({\n    grantIds: [...grantIds],\n    startedAt,\n    ...(owner ? { ownerUserId: owner } : {}),\n  });\n\n  let firstError: unknown;\n  for (const recipient of recipients) {\n    try {\n      const grant = await OneLocationService.createGrant({\n        vaultOwnerToken,\n        recipientUserId: recipient.userId,\n        recipientKeyId: recipient.keyId,\n        durationHours: 8,\n        reason: normalizedNote || \"sos_panic\",\n        shareKind: \"sos\",\n      });\n      // Record the grant id BEFORE publish so it is never orphaned even if\n      // publish throws for this or a later recipient, and persist it at once\n      // so a crash before the next create leaves a stoppable record behind.\n      grantIds.push(grant.id);\n      saveSosIncident(incidentSoFar());\n      const alerted = await publish(grant, recipient, point);\n      delivery.push({\n        userId: recipient.userId,\n        displayName: recipient.displayName,\n        alerted: typeof alerted === \"boolean\" ? alerted : null,\n      });\n    } catch (error) {\n      firstError ??= error;\n      delivery.push({\n        userId: recipient.userId,\n        displayName: recipient.displayName,\n        alerted: false,\n        failed: true,\n      });\n    }\n  }\n  if (firstError !== undefined) {\n    throw new SosPanicError(\n      firstError instanceof Error ? firstError.message : \"Could not send SMS alert.\",\n      grantIds.length ? incidentSoFar() : null,\n      delivery,\n    );\n  }\n  // Keep every created grant stoppable, including those whose publication\n  // failed. Failure for one contact never prevents the remaining attempts.\n  const incident = incidentSoFar();\n  saveSosIncident(incident);\n  return { ...incident, delivery };\n}","rendered_evidence":"PENDING production-composed state"},{"owner":"hushh-webapp/lib/one-location/saved-locations.ts","line":56,"name":"defaultSavedLocationCategory","exact_source_template":"export function defaultSavedLocationCategory(\n  existing: readonly Pick<SavedLocation, \"category\">[] = [],\n): SavedLocationCategory {\n  const taken = new Set(existing.map((location) => location.category));\n  if (!taken.has(\"home\")) return \"home\";\n  if (!taken.has(\"work\")) return \"work\";\n  return \"other\";\n}","rendered_evidence":"PENDING production-composed state"},{"owner":"hushh-webapp/lib/one-location/saved-locations.ts","line":124,"name":"asRecord","exact_source_template":"function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {\n  return value && typeof value === \"object\" && !Array.isArray(value)\n    ?
